path_step: Teacher attempts to save course information with an empty title.
test_scenario: Verify that the system prevents saving course information when the course title is empty and displays an appropriate error message.
test_case_title: Edit Course - Empty Course Title Validation
pre_condition: Teacher is logged in and on the Course Details page, and the 'Modify Course' modal is open for an existing course.
expected_result: System displays an error message indicating that the course title cannot be empty (e.g., "Title cannot be empty."), and the Teacher remains on the 'Modify Course' modal.
post_condition: Course information is not updated. Teacher can correct the title or cancel the editing process.

test_steps.step: Click on an existing course to go to the Course Details Page.
Click the 'Edit' button on the course information tab to open the 'Modify Course' modal.
Enter valid data into other editable fields (if any), such as the course image URL.
Click the 'Send Button' (Save) to submit the changes.

uncovered_conditions: AF1: Invalid Data - Course Title Empty
